events.name: Andy Grammer - Greater Than Pt. II: A One Man Show
events.info: An intimate, high-energy evening with multi-platinum artist Andy Grammer. Stripped to its core, this one-man show blends acoustic performance, spoken word, storytelling, and real-time audience connection into something deeply personal and undeniably uplifting. With only a piano, a guitar, and a room full of voices, Andy turns the stage into a shared experience: moving effortlessly between chart-topping hits, new songs, and the stories behind them. Raw, funny, and fully present, it's an invitation into the heart of the music.

events.name: Run Run Rudolph - Shaun Johnson Christmas
events.info: Dinner service begins TWO HOURS before the scheduled showtime. Your ticket includes our house greens salad with choice of dressing, basket of dinner rolls with butter, and a selection of entrée options, along with coffee and water. All other drinks such as alcohol, soda, tea, starters, entrée upgrades and desserts are available for purchase during your Ingersoll dining experience. The Run, Run Rudolph Tour is the 2026 holiday edition of The Big Band Experience, led by Emmy® Award winner Shaun Johnson, longtime frontman of Tonic Sol-fa and an artist with a Top 5 Billboard® album. Shaun has appeared in national television performances on NBC, and his band's music has been featured on HBO. The show blends classic big band swing with holiday standards and seasonal favorites, delivered through tight arrangements and a modern stage presentation.
events.pleaseNote: **Timing of Dinner: Dinner seating begins TWO HOURS before show time. *For a 1:00 pm matinee performance, please arrive between 11:00am and 11:30am. *For a 7:30 pm evening performance, please arrive between 5:30pm and 6:00pm. **Dinner: Every ticket to The Ingersoll includes a delicious dining experience. Enjoy your meal in the theater before the show, making your night truly unforgettable. **Club Seating: Tables 38-49 are Club Level seats upstairs and can be accessed using the stairs or the lift. Tables 42 through 49 are high-top tables. The Club Level has a private bar and private restrooms. **Seating Information: Our venue has cabaret seating, which means that you and your party may be sharing a table with other guests. When purchasing your tickets, please purchase seats across from each other (i.e. seats 1 and 2, 3 and 4, or 5 and 6). **Children: While family friendly shows are available, infants are not permitted in the theater. Children ages 5 and older are welcome.
